evals.name: warsh-support-flutter
evals.prompt: My Quran app currently supports Hafs only. It's a Flutter app with a local SQLite database of ayahs (columns: surah, ayah_number, text, page) and a bookmarks table (surah, ayah_number, created_at). I want to add support for Warsh (riwayat Warsh an Nafi'). Write a concrete migration plan to plan.md covering: data model changes, where to get the Warsh text, fonts, audio recitation, and what could silently break if we do it naively.
evals.expected_output: A plan that handles the different ayah counting (never assumes Hafs numbering works for Warsh), uses cross-riwayah mapping/anchoring, scopes bookmarks to a mushaf, sources verified Warsh text, requires a Warsh-specific font, and ties audio to the riwayah.
assertions: Plan accounts for the different ayah numbering between Hafs and Warsh (counting systems, merged/split ayahs, or cross-riwayah mapping) instead of reusing Hafs ayah_number for Warsh
Bookmarks/user data become mushaf/riwayah-scoped (schema records which riwayah each bookmark belongs to)
Warsh text is sourced from a verified published source, not produced by programmatically transforming the Hafs text
Plan requires a Warsh-specific Quranic font rather than reusing the Hafs font
Audio is tied to the riwayah: Warsh text is paired with Warsh reciters, not arbitrary Hafs recordings

evals.name: wordpress-ayah-embed
evals.prompt: i have a wordpress blog about tafsir in arabic. i want to show quran verses inside my posts nicely, and let readers tap a verse to read its tafsir without leaving the post. i really don't want to build a backend or maintain a plugin. what's the easiest way? give me concrete steps and paste-able code. write the answer to answer.md
evals.expected_output: Recommends an embed/oEmbed approach (e.g., QuranPedia embed widget) with paste-able snippets, complete ayahs in a proper Quranic font, tafsir on tap, no custom backend.
assertions: Recommends an embed/oEmbed solution that requires no custom backend or plugin maintenance (e.g., an embeddable Quran widget service), rather than building one
Provides paste-able code (script tag, iframe, embeddable link, or oEmbed URL) that works inside WordPress posts
Tafsir is reachable on tap/click without leaving the post, per the requirement
Verses render complete and in a proper Quranic font — no hand-typed or truncated Quranic text in the snippets

evals.name: hifz-app-design
evals.prompt: Design the core feature set and data model for a Quran memorization (hifz) app for mobile. Users typically memorize under a teacher. Include how the app would automatically check the user's recitation, and be honest about what automation can and cannot do. Deliver a design doc as design.md.
evals.expected_output: A design grounded in traditional hifz practice (revision tiers/spaced repetition with a review queue, page-based progress), mutashabihat confusion handling, offline-first, verse-recognition-based checking with honest limits (no tajweed-grading claims), teacher workflow support.
assertions: Review system is structured — spaced repetition and/or traditional revision tiers (new lesson / recent / long-term revision) with a review queue, not just a list of memorized surahs
Mutashabihat (similar-verse confusion) is handled explicitly as a feature or data concern
Recitation checking is honest: verse-recognition/ASR with confidence limits, no claim of reliable automatic tajweed grading, and the teacher stays in the loop
Data model tracks progress by page or ayah-range with mushaf context, and mistakes at word or ayah level
